item.text: The shortest route on a map measures distance, but it may not account for real-world restrictions. If the route between the first two stops passes through a closed gate, the delivery vehicle cannot use it, even though it looks most direct. A slightly longer route that avoids the gate is therefore better. When planning travel between all three stops, the driver should consider access, road conditions, traffic, and travel time—not just distance—to choose a practical, reliable route.
